description: The counter precondition of the public API (API-R70): one strong entity tag (v1alpha1/strong-etag-cases.json) whose value is a positive revision counter in canonical decimal form, ASCII digits without sign or leading zero. httpx.ParseRevisionETag is its one reader; the public handlers of every RequiredIfMatch and IfMatch counter parameter answer anything else with 400 invalid_request, Managed Eval mutations with 422 eval_invalid, never with a revision conflict. A request that requires the precondition carries exactly one If-Match header and no If-None-Match header. valid pairs a header value with its revision; invalid values match neither the readers nor the OpenAPI pattern; outOfRange values match the OpenAPI pattern, which cannot bound magnitude, but exceed 2^64-1 and are rejected; repeatedHeaders are If-Match header sets that are not one header.
